questions.content:
Copper reduces NO into NO and NO2 depending upon the concentration of HNO3 in solution. (Assuming fixed [Cu2+] and PNO = PNO2), the HNO3 concentration at which the thermodynamic tendency for reduction of NO into NO and NO2 by copper is same is 10x M. The value of 2x is _______. (Rounded off to the nearest integer)

[Given, V, V, V and at 298 K, (2.303) = 0.059]
